appearances.summary: prime-rl v0.10.0 makes INTELLECT Policy Optimization the default async RL algorithm and adds optimized training for DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen3.8 Flash Next, Nemotron-H, and multimodal Qwen-VL and Kimi K2.5. On agentic SWE RL, IPO trained through a trainer-inference KL spike that collapsed IcePop, and verifiers 0.4.0 ships a v1-only eval CLI.
